Title: Commercial Planning & Data Lead
Description: Sobre Birdman En Birdman estamos construyendo una de las empresas de nutrición y bienestar plant-based de mayor crecimiento en México. Operamos en un entorno dinámico, multicanal y en constante evolución, donde tomar mejores decisiones a partir de datos es fundamental para seguir creciendo de manera rentable y sostenible. Como parte de nuestro equipo de Revenue Growth Management , buscamos a una persona que quiera transformar datos, demanda e inventarios en decisiones comerciales de alto impacto. Sobre la posición Buscamos un/a Commercial Planning & Data Lead que se convierta en dueño/a del número único de demanda de Birdman , conectando forecast, inventarios, datos y visión financiera para apoyar la toma de decisiones del negocio. Tu reto será asegurar que tengamos el inventario correcto, en el lugar correcto y en el momento correcto, minimizando quiebres, sobreinventario y riesgo de caducidad, mientras entiendes y cuantificas el impacto de cada decisión en revenue, margen y capital de trabajo . Trabajarás de manera transversal con Revenue, Supply Chain, Producción, Finanzas, Data & BI y nuestros diferentes canales comerciales en México y Estados Unidos. Este no es únicamente un rol de planeación: buscamos a alguien capaz de construir modelos, automatizar procesos, cuestionar supuestos y convertir análisis complejos en decisiones accionables para el negocio . ¿Qué harás? Ser dueño/a del ciclo mensual de forecast de demanda end-to-end , consolidando un único número para la compañía. Analizar demanda, tendencias, estacionalidades, promociones y desviaciones para mejorar continuamente la precisión del forecast. Administrar la asignación comercial de inventarios entre canales y almacenes. Monitorear niveles de inventario, días de inventario, OOS, fill rate, OTIF y riesgo de caducidad. Cuantificar en dinero el revenue at risk por OOS y el costo asociado al sobreinventario. Construir business cases para decisiones de inventario, considerando su impacto en margen, cash y capital de trabajo. Evaluar escenarios como rebalanceos entre almacenes, compras extraordinarias, liquidaciones, donaciones o destrucción de inventario. Liderar la sección de forecast e inventarios dentro del MBR, transformando métricas en interpretación, acciones y resultados. Trabajar de manera cercana con Supply y Producción dentro de la cadencia de S&OP. Entregar insumos de cierre con visión P&L en coordinación con Finanzas. Construir y automatizar reportes, alertas y procesos que permitan tomar decisiones más rápidas. Utilizar SQL, Excel/Power Query, herramientas de BI, IA y scripting para explotar información y reducir procesos manuales. Documentar procesos, decisiones, supuestos y runbooks para construir una operación escalable y auditable. El rol es dueño del input de demanda y de la asignación comercial del inventario ; no será responsable de planear producción ni de liderar S&OP end-to-end. Requirements ¿Qué buscamos? 3 a 6 años de experiencia en Demand Planning, FP&A, Commercial Finance, Revenue Management, Business Operations, consultoría estratégica o posiciones similares. Experiencia siendo dueño/a de un ciclo recurrente de forecast o proyección financiera de principio a fin . Experiencia en empresas de consumo masivo (CPG), retail, Food & Beverage, suplementos/nutrición o industrias similares. Experiencia administrando inventarios o demanda en múltiples canales. Capacidad para conectar decisiones operativas con su impacto financiero. Experiencia construyendo modelos, business cases y análisis de escenarios. Experiencia trabajando con múltiples stakeholders y áreas funcionales. Historial de construcción o automatización de reportes/procesos que posteriormente hayan sido utilizados por otras personas. Deseable experiencia en operaciones multicanal, eCommerce o multi-país. Conocimientos técnicos Buscamos un perfil altamente analítico y hands-on: Excel avanzado + Power Query + modelado financiero SQL Power BI u otra herramienta de Business Intelligence Uso productivo de IA generativa y scripting para automatización Conocimiento de forecasting: series de tiempo, baseline + uplift, WMAPE/MAPE, bias y análisis de causa raíz. Conocimientos sólidos de S&OP y administración de inventarios: DOI, stock de seguridad, asignación, OTIF y fill rate. Capacidad para leer un P&L y explicar cómo una decisión operativa impacta margen y capital de trabajo. Python para automatización de reportes y alertas Experiencia con herramientas de Demand Planning como Netstock, Slimstock o SAP IBP Formación Carrera terminada en áreas como: Ingeniería Industrial Actuaría Economía Matemáticas Aplicadas Administración Finanzas Contaduría O carreras afines MBA o maestría en Finanzas/Economía será considerada una señal positiva. Idioma Inglés profesional avanzado (C1+) indispensable. La posición tiene exposición a la operación de Estados Unidos. ¿Qué te hará destacar? Buscamos a alguien con una combinación poco común: capacidad analítica + visión financiera + ejecución + ownership . Una persona que no espere a que alguien le diga qué analizar; que detecte anomalías, cuestione el dato, llegue a la causa raíz y construya una solución que evite que el mismo problema vuelva a ocurrir. Alguien cómodo/a trabajando como contribuidor individual , tomando decisiones con autonomía y construyendo procesos mientras los ejecuta. Nuestros principios especialmente importantes para esta posición son Ownership & Proactiveness y Big Thinking & Highest Standards . Modalidad y ubicación 📍 Corporativo Birdman — Guadalajara, Jalisco 🏢 Modalidad 100% presencial ¿Listo/a para despegar? Si disfrutas transformar datos en decisiones, construir modelos desde cero y entender no solo cuánto inventario tenemos , sino cuánto dinero está en juego y qué deberíamos hacer al respecto , queremos conocerte. ¡Únete a Birdman y emprende el vuelo con nosotros! 🚀

Title: Junior AI/ML Engineer
Description: We are hiring Junior AI/ML Engineers to help build AI agents that handle customer conversations through voice and chat. You'll work on the retrieval, orchestration, APIs, and integrations behind these systems, helping turn working prototypes into reliable production solutions. You'll collaborate with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to develop AI-powered experiences that are practical, secure, and effective. We welcome candidates with relevant professional experience, internships, research, or hands-on projects who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to real-world AI applications. What You'll Do Build AI agents: Develop conversational agents that interact with users, call tools and APIs, and hand conversations off to human agents when needed. Develop retrieval pipelines: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that help AI agents answer questions using approved information sources. Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and messaging channels. Build and manage APIs: Work with API gateways, authentication, rate limits, and versioning. Support voice AI development: Help build voice agents using speech-to-text, large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech in English and Spanish. Test and improve quality: Use evaluations, automated tests, and guardrails to improve accuracy, reliability, and safety. Support deployment and monitoring: Ship and maintain solutions through CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, CX design, and operations colleagues to turn prototypes into production-ready solutions. Our Technology Stack Our primary cloud platform is Microsoft Azure, but experience with AWS or Google Cloud is also valuable. Relevant technologies include Python, Git, Docker, SQL, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, API gateways, webhooks, messaging systems, and cloud-based AI services. Experience with any one of the named tools in each relevant area is sufficient. You don't need to have used every framework or platform listed. Working Environment This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Colombia or Mexico. You'll work with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to build and improve AI-powered customer conversation solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to AI agents, retrieval systems, integrations, and voice AI applications while developing your engineering skills. ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Live Interview Please Note ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. Requirements: What You'll Bring 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering. Relevant internships and research experience count. Solid Python skills and familiarity with Git, Docker, and basic SQL. Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Hands-on experience with an LLM API, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI. Experience building an AI agent that calls tools or APIs, using a framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. Experience building a RAG pipeline, including document chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval tuning. Experience building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, rate limits, and versioning, with some exposure to API gateways. Experience connecting systems through webhooks, SDKs, or message queues, such as integrating an application with a CRM or database. Understanding of ML fundamentals, including embeddings, train/test splits, and evaluation metrics such as precision and recall. Professional written and spoken English and Spanish. Based in Colombia or Mexico. Candidates with strong foundational knowledge and relevant academic, internship, research, or personal project experience are encouraged to apply. Nice to Have Experience with speech AI or voice agent technologies, such as Azure AI Speech, Whisper, LiveKit, or Pipecat. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps or n8n. Experience with CRM and contact center APIs, including Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or Zendesk. Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as Langfuse or Ragas. Cloud AI certifications or other relevant technical certifications.

The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com Job Description The Data Products Team builds and certifies the data products that power outage management and reliability reporting. The team owns the full data lifecycle, from raw source feeds to validated, stakeholder-ready outputs. We’re looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and maintain ETL pipelines, implement data quality validations, and support the delivery of certified, versioned data products. You will work closely with the team and operational stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and readiness for downstream reporting and business use. Responsibilities Build and maintain scalable ETL pipelines using AWS Glue, Spark, and Athena to process modem telemetry, outage events, and customer impact data. Develop and manage daily data quality checks, including SQL validations, threshold-based alerts, and row-count monitoring. Investigate data anomalies such as nulls, duplicates, missing intervals, and unexpected data distributions, resolving issues before they affect downstream systems. Integrate data from multiple upstream systems, including AOM, IPDR, Scope, CARS, IRIS, and Gisual , to produce unified, validated datasets. Support data product certification by validating outputs and ensuring they meet established quality standards before stakeholder delivery. Coordinate versioned data product releases, including test case development, release notes, go/no-go decisions with end users, and patches through a structured release process. Document data validation methodologies, pipeline behavior, and release processes. Collaborate with data engineering teammates and BI and operational stakeholders throughout the data delivery lifecycle. Qualifications Strong proficiency in SQL , including window functions (LAG, PARTITION BY), grouping sets, null handling, and Athena-specific query patterns. Experience with Python for scripting, automation, and data validation. Hands-on experience with AWS data services, particularly Glue, Athena, S3, EMR, and Step Functions . Experience using Spark for large-scale data processing, preferably on EMR. Strong understanding of data quality and the ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes, and determine when data does not look correct. Experience validating data pipelines and ensuring data accuracy and consistency before downstream consumption. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document technical methodologies and coordinate effectively with teammates and stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience working with telecommunications or network operations data , including modem telemetry, outage records, or IPDR-style data feeds.
